{{Quote|I am having the most wonderful time here on my vacation. First a gronda killing, and now police excitement!|Snee-Roos|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Snee-Roos''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was visiting the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] on vacation. During his stay on the planet, he recorded a poacher illegally [[Death/Legends|killing]] a [[Gronda]] near [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]]. When [[Gilker Budz]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] learned of this [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]], he sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to meet Snee-Roos and bring the recording to Budz.

==Behind the scenes==
Snee-Roos was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. He appeared during a quest given out by [[Gilker Budz]], in which the player had to travel to a specified location and talk to Snee-Roos to retrieve a [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]].

Due to the way these missions were designed by the developers, Snee-Roos wore different [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] each time a player ran this mission. Usually the look and even gender and [[Species/Legends|species]] of such characters also changed each time, but as the game used the same model for all Gran, Snee-Roos' face always looked the same.
